observations.note: The arrangement builds to a solid peak here with intensified drumming, though the dynamic shift is somewhat compressed.
The sitar is distinct and easily followed during the isolated opening segment.
The sitar melody remains present but begins to compete with the rhythm guitars for midrange clarity.
The guitar tone provides decent heavy context but feels slightly digital and lacks deep resonance.
The rhythm section drives the track steadily but leans slightly toward a mechanical feel.
The audio file cuts off abruptly at the tail end before the final notes can naturally decay.
The minor-key tonality of the raga establishes an appropriately dark atmosphere when the heavy instrumentation hits.

overall_note: The track achieves a cohesive blend of Indian classical elements and metal backing, though the mid-heavy mix creates some masking during the busier sections.
